steps.note: Quintero at the lock with no stance given: the player asks 'Why twice the people?' and gets her secret (Fraser and Ferreira). Then the core copy, once she was wounded in the WREN beat: one arm is plenty for a door.

said: He wants you on your own.
When he ran his countdown, I asked the Council for a second team. They said no.
Two of ours died at the sites nobody covered. Fraser and Ferreira.
One arm's plenty for a door. You've got work.
